# exp/chakra-seal — eye-check gate (F-format)

**Method.** All marks generated by `build.py` from `iconography/geometry/grid.json`
(no freehand geometry); battery rendered via the Phase-0 pipeline
(`render_html_to_png.py`, vendored fonts, colors.css) and inspected at full
size. Findings below; every ship-blocking item is either fixed in this branch
or explicitly carried.

| # | Check | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Full yantra on ivory — engraving discipline (two weights, gold only at god-points) | PASS — reads as constructed instrument, not clip-art |
| 2 | Gold-line yantra on indigo (sacred night) | PASS — the strongest single render in the battery |
| 3 | Favicon 16/24/32/48, light + dark | PASS — bindu-in-ring reads at 16 px on both themes; first mark in the system that does |
| 4 | Wheel in circle-crop avatar | PASS — after fix: petals narrowed (0.86×) + midribs added; pre-fix wheel read sunflower-generic |
| 5 | Poster header sim (seal + white-golddot wordmark on indigo) | PASS |
| 6 | Receipt header sim (wheel at 74 px + donation lockup) | PASS — wheel chosen over full yantra per sanctity ladder (operational rung) |
| 7 | 6 cm mono sim | PASS — medallions hold as dots; hub solid; no gray mush |
| 8 | Nālī variant | PASS as ceremonial option — index notch legible at hero size, sub-legible below ~120 px (use rotationally-pure form there) |
| 9 | Medallion legibility under 48 px | KNOWN LIMIT — answered by the ladder (switch form, never shrink the yantra) |
| 10 | Specimen tiles show dark variants on light ground | CARRIED — battery specimen grid is light-only; dark variants get dark tiles in the Phase-2 comparison page |

**Net:** direction viable; flagship-quality on ceremonial surfaces; ladder
solves small sizes. Carries: specimen dark tiles (#10) to comparison page.
